promise: India will generate 100 GW of nuclear power by 2047
description: In his Independence Day 2026 address from the Red Fort on August 15, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a mega nuclear push, aiming for 100 GW of nuclear power capacity by 2047 as part of the Viksit Bharat development roadmap.
evidence: August 15, 2026 Independence Day speech announcing 100 GW nuclear target by 2047
